content:
I was trying to write an explanation doc and engage with GPT to understand why we need an rcaes in this proof , and GPT suggested that it can be simplified since the upstream Measure.comp_assoc no longer require the nonempty claim. I tested quickly over the online lean website and it does. So i made a PR.

More precisely, In Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Invariance, the proof of Kernel.Invariant.comp currently splits into the IsEmpty α and Nonempty α cases. But the current version of Measure.comp_assoc does not require a Nonempty α instance, so the direct rewriting proof also handles the empty case.
